jobs.occupation: Investor Acquisition Manager - Investment Management Firm
jobs.description:
Our client is an international investment firm specializing in discretionary portfolio management for private and institutional investors. Active across Belgium and Luxembourg, the company benefits from a strong reputation and continued growth throughout European markets.

Jobomschrijving

• Contact and qualify high-net-worth prospects generated through marketing campaigns, and develop your own prospect opportunities
• Develop investor interest and schedule advisory meetings
• Conduct multiple discussions with prospects and guide them through the decision-making process until investment commitment
• Support clients throughout the account opening and funding process
• Achieve commercial targets in terms of outreach, meetings, and new client acquisition
• Develop your expertise in wealth management through a structured training program
• Collaborate closely with portfolio management and client service teams to deliver an outstanding client experience

• Degree in Finance, Economics, Business or equivalent professional experience
• Minimum 5 years of successful sales or business development experience within financial services
• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a professional command of English
• Proven track record in acquiring high-net-worth clients and generating new investment business
• Strong consultative selling skills and confidence discussing investment-related topics
• Entrepreneurial mindset, resilience and excellent relationship-building abilities

Our client is a european fintech operating in the financial services and payments sector. Its Brussels-based offices offer a dynamic, modern and easily accessible working environment within a rapidly evolving industry.

Jobomschrijving

• Act as the AML Compliance Officer and oversee the organisation's AML/CFT framework
• Supervise KYC, CDD, sanctions screening, PEP reviews and transaction monitoring activities
• Manage, coach and develop a team of 6 compliance professionals
• Review and validate complex investigations and escalate sensitive cases when required
• Maintain and enhance AML/CFT policies, procedures and internal controls
• Coordinate regulatory reporting, audits and compliance reviews
• Collaborate closely with legal, risk and operational teams to ensure regulatory compliance

• Unlimited right to work in Belgium is mandatory for this position : applications without a valid work permit will not be considered.
• Degree in Law, Finance, Compliance, Risk Management or a related field
• Minimum 7 years of experience in AML/CFT, compliance or financial crime within financial services, payments or fintech
• Fluent in English; proficiency in French and/or Dutch is considered an advantage
• Strong knowledge of Belgian and European AML regulations, KYC/CDD, sanctions and transaction monitoring
• Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills
• Proven experience leading and developing compliance teams

jobs.occupation: Operations Coordinator - Dutch & German speaking m/f/d (Callcenteragent/in)
jobs.description: **Location:**  GhentClient confidentialTransport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. This is us, your new colleaguesYou will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.This is the job- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business Are you the one?- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.- Well-being services- Restaurant on site- Opportunity to grow within the company- Good work life balance- International environment- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

We are looking for a production worker with a good knowledge of English. Are you handy and able to work with a pneumatic nail gun?

This company, located in Lokeren, is a growing family business specializing in the production, repair, and recycling of wooden pallets. To strengthen their team, we are looking for a motivated pallet repairer. Do you enjoy hands-on, repetitive work, and do you not shy away from physical labor? Then you might be the colleague the company is looking for. 
Your tasks:
• Assembling and repairing wooden pallets according to our quality standards.
• Working with a pneumatic nail gun.
• Sorting pallets by type and quality.
• Keeping your workspace clean, organized, and safe.
• Collaborating with your colleagues to meet daily production targets.
 

What we ask of you:
• You enjoy working with tools and like manual labor.
• You are physically fit and willing to work at a steady pace.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality.
• You can express yourself in English; having another native language is no problem (but English is a must).

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English, spoken and written.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

Do you enjoy precision shaping pipes and creating strong welds for technical installations? As a TIG or semi-automatic welder, you'll work on a variety of HVAC projects within the construction sector. You'll read plans, build custom installations, and weld pipes into perfect assemblies for heating and plumbing. Depending on the project, you'll work both on-site and in the workshop, preparing and assembling components. Thanks to the variety of high-end projects, your job remains technically challenging and educational. You'll be part of a large team where collaboration, quality, and safety are paramount.

What are your tasks?

• Reading and interpreting technical plans
• Bending, grinding, and welding pipes (TIG/semi-automatic)
• Preparing and assembling installations in the workshop and on-site

• Experience as a welder in a technical or construction environment
• Communicate in English or Romanian
• Possession of a driver's license

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment in food in necassery.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

For our customer in Houthalen we're searching for an Estimating Engineer.

Your key responsibilities:

• Conducting detailed analysis of project specifications and drawings to accurately estimate costs associated with materials, labor, and equipment
• Determine cost estimate targets during the design and development process, recommending cost effective solutions
• Working cross-functionally with project managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to gather comprehensive details for precise estimation
• Gather proposals, specifications and related documents and liaise with stakeholders in order to convert specifications to cost estimates for new and current machines
• Reviewing bids from subcontractors and vendors for conformity to project requirements and overall budgetary constraints
• Implementing best practices in cost estimation and establishing protocols for regular updating and revising of estimates
• Establish cost estimates of production processes and tooling costs and review alternatives or put forward recommendations for improvement
• Presenting, explaining, and justifying project estimates to senior management and relevant stakeholders
• Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, new technologies, and government regulations that could affect project costs
• Utilize cost methodologies and tools and appropriate software models and packages to prepare and maintain reliable and accurate data
• Assess cost effectiveness of products and track actual costs relative to budget and report status on a regular basis to ensure costs are in line with forecasts
•  Monitor and review data and information to detect or assess problems
• Investigate and identify cost reduction opportunities through cost analysis review
• Contribute to cost monitoring and reporting systems and procedures and monitor trends
• Prepare cost and expenditure statements, reports and other necessary documentation at regular intervals to share with others in the business
• Support all activities in cost estimating and take a proactive approach towards improvements
• Create sales layouts

• Relevant business or manufacturing/engineering degree preferred, BsC or MsC
• Some previous experience of cost estimating, ideally in an machine building, manufacturing or engineering environment
• Good IT systems knowledge and skills including advanced SAP and Excel skills
• Ideally experienced in the use of spreadsheets, estimating pricing models and cost management tools
• Able to show evidence of adding value and cost optimization
• Knowledge and understanding of a variety of manufacturing/automotive processes and components and ability to evaluate and analyze associated costs
• Experience in manufacturing and design environment, mechanical engineering
• Knowledge of 3D design software (Inventor, AutoCAD)
• Knowledge of various production techniques: milling, turning, welding, sheet metal working, assembly
• Good knowledge drives
• Willing to travel
• Bilingual (Dutch-English)

Onze klant is een dynamische, internationale KMO met een familiaal karakter. Ze hebben een hart voor interieurdecoratie en industriële kunststoftoepassingen.

Jobomschrijving

As the backbone of our export team, you create happy customers by offering a hassle-free service from A to Z. You report to the team lead and work together with the sales director, other customer care officers and sales managers.

• You manage the whole ordering process of a specific customer portfolio, from quotation to shipment, including customs procedures. You are responsible for the correct follow-up of pricing and conditions.  You also work on the credit and collection cycle.
• As the backbone of the company, you find the balance between customer care and organizational possibilities. For that, you work in close contact with colleagues from other departments such as supply chain and finance.
• We take customer engagement to the next level by following up on lead generation and by translating our global marketing plan to country-specific initiatives.
• You handle complaints and give the full customer experience while doing so.
• As a product expert, you provide advice and answers to technical or inspirational questions.
• You create real ‘wow’-moments along the customer journey of your client. We provide several tools for you to use, but your commercial feeling will help you make the right decision.
• Obviously, you are in very close contact with your sales colleagues. They support you and vice versa.

• You understand what a top-notch customer experience is about. You love to deliver results above customer expectations. Your mature nature and great communicative skills help you in this challenge.
• Your problem-solving skills in combination with your optimism make you a perfect customer-care enthusiast.
• You have a hands-on personality. You are not afraid to take on challenges outside of your daily job.
• You have a master’s or bachelor’s degree.
• You have a good English command and you speak at least one other language (German, Spanish, Italian,…)
• Knowledge of SAP and customs is a big plus, but no deal breaker. We love to teach you all about it.
• You live in the near vicinity of our Ostend office.
